summary: ParaZero Technologies filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing an initial order for DefendAir Net Pods and integration support from a new U.S.-based defense manufacturer. This is an ordinary commercial order, not a special situation or corporate event. No financial terms, stake, price per share, premium, closing date, advisor, or board recommendation were disclosed. The filing carries no structural mechanics or regulatory clock. From a risk-arb angle, there is no deal to trade; the event carries no arb implication.
